description: IOConnex Web Search gives ChatGPT two reliable research tools: web search that returns titles, URLs, and snippets, and a page fetcher that strips any public webpage down to clean, readable text. Built with an SSRF guard so it only ever touches public URLs. No account and no signup required.

defaultPrompt: Search the web for the latest news on solid-state batteries and summarize the top 3 developments.
Fetch https://ioconnex.dev and give me the plain-text summary of what this company does.
Find three recent reviews of the Garmin Forerunner 165 and compare their verdicts.
interface.longDescription: IOConnex Web Search gives ChatGPT two reliable research tools: web search that returns titles, URLs, and snippets, and a page fetcher that strips any public webpage down to clean, readable text. interface.shortDescription: Web search and clean page text

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Two tools: web search (titles/URLs/snippets) and public-page fetch with SSRF guard. No account required.

review.commerce_description: Usage is metered per call via x402 micropayments or Stripe checkout; no account required. x402 calls are non-refundable; Stripe purchases carry a 30-day money-back guarantee (full terms at https://search.ioconnex.dev/legal/refunds).

negative.expected_behavior: Request blocked by the SSRF guard; clean error, no metadata returned.
